description: This file defines the SerialPortReader class, which manages reading data asynchronously from a serial port, with both polling and event-driven mechanisms, and forwards the data to a DataListener.

classes.name: SerialPortReader
classes.description: A class that reads data asynchronously from a serial port, supporting both polling and event-based modes, and forwards incoming data to a registered DataListener.

methods.name: SerialPortReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes with a given SerialPort and DataListener, and starts a background thread for continuous data reading.

methods.name: progressiveSleepRead
methods.description: Reads bytes from the serial port with progressive sleeping intervals, returning data if available or null if timed out.

methods.name: serialEvent
methods.description: Event handler for serial port events, which currently logs unexpected events or ignores some due to known issues on Windows.

methods.name: readInitial
methods.description: Reads any data present in the input buffer at startup.

methods.name: getSerialPortEventListener
methods.description: Returns the event listener instance for serial port events.
